title: Versioned common geometry recipe kills the duplicate cold geometry construction
model_note: routing: GLM via Z.ai; no other model identity claimed

design.recipe: GeometryRecipe = frozen identity dict (geometry_identity + policy override + implementation closure extended with geometry/service.py and geometry/recipe.py fingerprints), frozen via canonical-JSON round-trip; digest = sha256(canonical_json(identity)); source paths + real producer (normalize + svf_calculator_compact) attached; export_identity() carries construction/exporter_implementation/operation_policy SEPARATELY and never enters the native key.
design.guarantee: both routes derive the same recipe -> same native key -> GeometryStore.get_or_create serves one construction cold, zero warm; producer is the only oracle.
design.pipeline_trust: pipeline.py keeps its trusted-legacy branch by extending a COPY of the recipe identity (trusted_legacy=fingerprints); never mutates the shared recipe.

gate1_source_bound_bitwise_parity.per_field: 19/19 RESULT_NAMES bitwise equal for recipe_vs_standalone, recipe_vs_pipeline, standalone_vs_pipeline on both scenes
gate1_source_bound_bitwise_parity.normalized_inputs: clamped tree, vegdem(trees+dem), vegdsm(trees+a), vegdsm2, bush, amaxvalue, scale all bitwise equal

recipe_level.result: svf producer calls == 1 for BOTH routes through one shared recipe; second route hit=True producer_calls=0; warm repeat 0 productions; 1 generation on disk

end_to_end.simulation: service half = exact diff post-image of geometry/service.py applied with git apply and loaded as pseudo-module; child half = identity-only patch (recipe_probe) making the tile worker derive numerical_geometry_recipe(...).identity, mirroring the diff's pipeline.py section; the child producer is the UNMODIFIED pipeline.py producer proven bitwise identical in gate 1; svf_calculator_compact only wrapped call-through

stages.baseline_cold: 2 svf calls (standalone 1, pipeline 1), 2 distinct keys, both produced (reproduces census C6-02)
stages.recipe_cold: 1 svf call TOTAL; standalone miss+produce (producer_calls=1), pipeline consult hit=True producer_calls=0; 1 shared key 7998d95e289bc799e50aa8c3b35a78ca531ac976c93e4d827e9cd2b9ca0cff0b, disjoint from both baseline keys

end_to_end.output_parity: baseline vs recipe outputs bitwise identical: output_folder/0_0 TIFF pixels AND bytes, SkyViewFactor TIFF, all svfs_0_0.zip members, all shadowmats_0_0.npz visibility channels
end_to_end.scope_statement: proven: one cold production per tile with the integration patch's exact service post-image plus the identity-only child patch, on a real thermal_comfort run. NOT yet proven: production counts on unpatched integrator code; that requires the integrator to apply integration_patch_C6-10.diff at C6-70 and re-run the census. The parent-side post-image is the real patched code; the child-side patch is identity-only (producer is real pipeline code).

cases.array_payload: svf.npy byte flipped at offset 512 after publication -> not served as hit; real producer rebuilt once; fields bitwise equal to reference
cases.visibility_payload: shmat sidecar payload byte flipped at offset 256 -> rejected and rebuilt; bitwise equal
cases.forged_manifest: manifest patch_option rewritten to 999 with recomputed self-consistent digest -> still rejected by identity check; rebuilt; bitwise equal
cases.stale_source: Trees.tif content changed (same geometry metadata) -> new key, old generation preserved, no stale hit, producer re-ran once; svftotal changed 2488 px on this motif

test_runs.command: PYTHONPATH=<worktree>/src NUMBA_NUM_THREADS=2 .venv-light/bin/python -m pytest tests/unit/test_geometry_service.py tests/unit/test_identities.py tests/unit/test_geometry_cache.py -q
test_runs.result: 80 passed, 2 warnings in 14.03s (base behavior untouched; 2 warnings are pre-existing zipfile UserWarnings from the cache test's own corruption fixtures)

environment.thread_cap: NUMBA_NUM_THREADS=2 set before numba imports; children additionally capped to 1 in runtime env
environment.host: contended development host, 8 sibling optimization workers; all wall times are development-tier records only - NO timing claims made
environment.fastmath: not used; existing njit(cache=True) policy untouched; math profile imports reused; warnings and np.seterr behavior preserved

scope_and_integrity.mocks: none for numerics; svf_calculator_compact only wrapped call-through to count invocations; service mocks limited to acquisition paths and labeled in test docstrings
scope_and_integrity.git_status: only owned untracked paths present; no branch created; no commit/push

unresolved: Real end-to-end single-production on unpatched integrator code awaits diff application at C6-70 (integration_patch_C6-10.diff, git apply --check verified; the e2e test validates the service post-image at runtime).

Integration-applier note: when applying with 'git apply --directory <root>', the --include pattern must match the REWRITTEN path (e.g. '*src/solweig_light/geometry/service.py'); a non-matching pattern silently skips the patch with exit 0.

construction/standalone_implementation handling: the patch moves construction into the separate export identity and drops standalone_implementation from the native key; if the integrator wants to retain a standalone-implementation fingerprint anywhere, it belongs in export_identity.exporter_implementation (content_fingerprint of the service wrapper), which the diff already supplies.
